source_checks.limits: Different retail products in the same historical FDA survey, with unequal sample counts and mixed origins. Basmati and jasmine categories include both brown and white products; preparation also varies. These are descriptive category averages, not matched grains, a cultivar effect, statistical significance or a current sourcing guarantee. FDA used substitutions for some non-speciated or non-detected samples. Rounded original averages are converted using the stated 45 g dry-rice serving; conversion adds no measurement precision.
